stories.title: Weight Configuration Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical schema for user-adjustable weights including measure_id, weight_value, normalization rules, bounds (e.g., 0–1), and optional user/session identifier. Ensure compatibility with both provider and clinical trial measures and define request/response contract for scoring APIs.
stories.evidence: GAP: No weighting or preference persistence system exists in frontend or backend

stories.title: Weighted Scoring Engine Extension
stories.description: Extend provider and clinical trial scoring engines to accept normalized weight inputs and recompute composite scores deterministically. Preserve default scoring behavior when weights are absent and ensure identical outputs for identical inputs (idempotency).

stories.title: Weights API and Optional Persistence
stories.description: Implement backend endpoints to accept and validate weight configurations and trigger score recalculation. Support stateless requests (weights passed per call) and optional persistence using MongoDB for session/user reuse.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py; Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; GAP: No existing preference persistence or weights API

stories.title: Frontend Weight Adjustment UI
stories.description: Add UI controls (e.g., sliders) for adjusting measure importance and submitting weights to backend. Display recalculated scores inline within chat responses, maintaining consistency with existing ChatWindow interaction patterns.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx; GAP: No UI for structured weight adjustment exists

stories.title: End-to-End Weighting Tests and Integration Validation
stories.description: Implement unit tests for schema validation and scoring logic, plus integration tests covering API calls and UI-triggered recalculation across provider and clinical trial flows. Validate normalization, edge cases, and deterministic outputs.
